answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The falcon edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 83 clones produces a signature the ridge analysis flags immediately. An adversary must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the saffron settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
